record_title: The k=7 case of Chu's divisor-sum conjecture for even perfect numbers
scientific_context: Proves the k=7 case of Chu's Conjecture 5: for n=2^(alpha-1)p^(beta-1), alpha,beta>1, with p an odd prime below 3*2^(alpha-1)-1, n divides sigma_7(n) exactly for the even perfect numbers other than 8128.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Only k=7 is resolved; higher Mersenne exponents remain open. The final bounded elimination is computer-assisted but exact and reproducible. The full text of Jiang (2018) was not inspected; its accessible abstract states the k=3 theorem. No formal proof-assistant verification or independent audit is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer verification of the bounded residual cases, the beta=4 constants, and a direct small-box sanity check.
